answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on Zh ⇒ En and De ⇒ En translation tasks.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we use the widely used metrics BLEU, BLEURT, and COMET. We use ScareBLEU, BLEURT-20 and Unbabel/wmt22-comet-da in the evaluation implementations.

answer_4.quote: We further conduct human evaluation to analyze the translation quality. We respectively randomly pick 100 sentences from Zh ⇒ En and De ⇒ En test sets, and recruit three human judges for evaluation. For each sentence, the judges read the source sentence and two candidate translations, which are from the random subset model and G-DIG subset model. The judges are required to rate each candidate on a scale of 1 to 5 and pick the better one.
answer_4.guideline: rate each candidate on a scale of 1 to 5 and pick the better one
